summary: Normalizes a floating-point angle in place to the range [-PI, PI]. If the value exceeds +PI it is reduced by 2*PI; if it is below -PI it is increased by 2*PI; values already in range pass through unchanged. Uses the +PI constant at 0x0059EFA4 and the 2*PI constant at 0x0059EFA8. Called by CollisionResponseFilter (004584c0).

local_names.this: angle value (single float) normalized in place

operations.description: Compares *this against +PI (flt_59EFA4, 3.1415927) and branches to the wrap-down path when it is strictly greater
On the less-or-equal path, checks whether *this is below -PI (flt_59EFA4 negated, -3.1415927)
When *this < -PI, wraps upward by adding 2*PI (flt_59EFA8, 6.2831855) into this+0x0
When *this > +PI, wraps downward by subtracting 2*PI (flt_59EFA8, 6.2831855) from this+0x0
Returns void; the normalized angle remains in this+0x0
Invoked by CollisionResponseFilter (004584c0) to normalize a collision angle before further processing

unresolved: The two PI constants are read from global floats (flt_59EFA4, flt_59EFA8); their write sites are outside this packet
